answer: Crystal is minted only as pay for a task the violet judges grade correct, at most one crystal per seat per epoch, and it cannot be transferred. The ocean records which seat admitted each newcomer. A sponsor admitting its k-th newcomer burns k² crystal. An honest sponsor admitting one stranger burns 1 crystal, one epoch of graded work. An operator admitting 30 clones through one seat burns 9,455 crystal, about 9,455 epochs of that seat's judged labour.
